mentions.name: daily.dev for Startups
mentions.description: This service helps early-stage, low-budget companies distribute their product, get in front of developers at scale, and increase product awareness.
mentions.problem: Distributing a product and finding developers at scale is hard, especially for early-stage companies on a low budget.
mentions.audience: Early-stage, low-budget companies that want to get in front of developers and increase awareness of their product.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I've been busy creating a solution for early stage companies who are low and budget but still want get in front of developers and increase awareness to their product. Hopefully it can help others.
daily.dev for Startups:
https://daily.dev/startups/
